brio_wu.scope: Coplanar gamma=2 Brio-Wu. No exact solution overlay or universal uniqueness claim.

alfven.scope: 1D circularly polarized nonlinear wave; exact conservative cell averages, including constant total energy.

field_loop.scope: Weak-field MHD translation diagnostic, not an exact finite-field solution. CT initializes face B with a corner-potential curl; GLM uses a cell-potential central curl. No equal-accuracy or matched-cost ranking. CT uses contact-upwinded edge EMF, not UCT-HLLD. GLM has ch=4, damping=0.18*ch/h and no psi contribution to total energy.

riemann_scope: HLLD fast/contact/Alfven fan, common Bn, zero-Bn and parallel-field degeneracies; invalid stars fall back to HLLE and counts are reported.
